name: csv_quoting
description: A minimal CSV reader and writer supporting quoted fields, escaped quotes, embedded newlines, header dictionaries and round-tripping.
bugs: parse_line() only emits the final field when it is non-empty, dropping trailing empty fields
parse_line() advances one character instead of two after an escaped quote, so the second quote closes the field
_needs_quotes() does not treat a quote character as needing quoting, so fields like 5" are written raw
